verdict.rationale: Natural-language-to-command generation is a fair axis for a terminal app, so it applies here. The evidence pack documents only a conventional Unix-like shell: built-in commands, `help -l`, the `pkg` installer, Shortcuts integration and a relay server. Nothing in it shows a feature that turns plain-language descriptions into shell commands.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can describe what I want in plain language and have the tool generate the corresponding shell command
